tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each line row in field "Lines"
    add item 2 of row * item 3 of row to total
  end repeat
  put round(total, 2) into field "Subtotal"
  put round(total * 0.1, 2) into field "VAT"
  put round(total * 1.1, 2) into field "Total"
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat for each line of field Lines, calling it row:
Add item 2 of row times item 3 of row to total.
Write total rounded to 2 decimals in field Subtotal.
Write total times 0.1 rounded to 2 decimals in field VAT.
Write total times 1.1 rounded to 2 decimals in field Total.

tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put empty into table
  repeat with n = 1 to 5
    if n = 1 then
      put (n & " x 5 = " & (n * 5)) into table
    else
      put table & return & (n & " x 5 = " & (n * 5)) into table
    end if
  end repeat
  put table into field "Table"
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat with n going from 1 to 5:
Write (n followed by " x 5 = " followed by (n times 5)) in table.
Write table followed by a line break followed by (n followed by " x 5 = " followed by (n times 5)) in table.

tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put 0 into wordCount
  repeat for each word currentWord in field "Text"
    if length(currentWord) > 4 then
      add 1 to wordCount
    end if
  end repeat
  put wordCount into field "Long"
end mouseUp

If the length of currentWord is greater than 4:

tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put empty into countdown
  repeat with n = 5 to 1 step -1
    if countdown is empty then
      put n into countdown
    else
      put countdown & return & n into countdown
    end if
  end repeat
  put countdown into field "Countdown"
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat with n going from 5 to 1, by steps of -1:
Write countdown followed by a line break followed by n in countdown.

tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put empty into result
  repeat for each line amount in field "Amounts"
    if result is empty then
      put (amount * 2) into result
    else
      put result & return & (amount * 2) into result
    end if
  end repeat
  put result into field "Doubled"
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat for each line of field Amounts, calling it amount:
Write result followed by a line break followed by (amount times 2) in result.
